name: abstate-template-cap
summary: Handler templates for AbStataIndex 792..slots-1, so a 2026 state past the 2016 range is attached (its effects applied, its packets sent) instead of skipped.
why: ?abstatetemplate (AbnormalStateContainer::AbnormalStateList, 0x877AD0) holds one handler object per AbStataIndex:
inline objects (most of them the generic AbnormalStateElement, {vtable 0x6A36BC, id} - 8 bytes; a few special
classes), a 792-slot pointer array at +0x265C, and at +0x32BC an array-list (vtable 0x6A44CC) built by
`push 0x318; call 0x40E0D0` - capacity and count 792 (u16 at +0x32C0), 12-byte entries at +0x32C4 whose first
dword points at the pointer-array slot of that index (the list links the entries itself). The constructor's tail
(0x4160CC..0x41613F) tags each object with its index and fills entry[i] for i < 792.
AbstateElementInObject::aeo_Set calls the template's methods (vtable+0x18 at 0x40A4B6, attach at 0x40A6CD...)
only for idx < count - so with the 2026 AbState table in (index up to 1093, abstate-index-cap), every state past
791 was set in the object's list but never ATTACHED: no stat effect, no packet (a bot on the 2026 data saw state
229 arrive and Gold Dragon's Grace, 1093, never). This gives those indexes the generic template:
- the list capacity 792 -> slots (the imm32 of the push at 0x41188D): count and entries grow, all linked;
- a cave at the constructor's end (0x416141, `mov eax, esi; mov ecx, [ebp-0xC]` moved into it) that, for
i = 792..slots-1, writes a generic object {0x6A36BC, i} and a pointer slot to it in this region and points
entry[i] at the slot - exactly what the constructor does for a generic index below 792 (its slot value comes
from vtable+0x24, 0x450350 = `mov eax, ecx; ret`, i.e. the object itself).
The inline pointer array keeps 792 slots: its only other reader, AbnormalStateList::operator[] (0x401850,
bound 0x317), has one caller (AbState::as_Load 0x416FCB) that discards the result. The region is in the RWX
arena (code + the objects the cave writes). New action kinds a 2026 state may need (SubAbState Type >= 120) stay
clamped to no-ops in the data (invented.json abstate_clamped) - this gives the states the generic behaviour.

new_section.name: .abtpl
new_section.note: Cave at +0, generic template objects at +0x100 (8 B each), their pointer slots after them. RWX arena.

code.why: after the constructor's own loop: generic templates + list entries for 792..slots-1, then resume

edits.why: the template list's capacity (push 0x318 at 0x41188D -> slots): count + entries for every index
constructor end: jmp to the cave (E9)
constructor end: jmp rel32 (replaces mov eax, esi / mov ecx, [ebp-0xC], both moved into the cave)
